threat: Charity impersonation at enrolment (fake officer claims a real charity)
attack_path: Registers in charity portal as 'officer' of a real EIN using public 990 data; submits own (mule) bank account with forged bank letter or micro-deposit-verified account
affected_assets: Destination record; first grants to that charity across sponsors
blast_radius_without_controls: Every sponsor paying that EIN once the destination is marked verified in a shared store
controls: Representative authority proof tied to independent source (officer on latest 990/state registry) + callback to org number from T1 source; bank-originated owner match to legal name/EIN; D1 tier cooling + first-payment cap + receipt confirmation; per-sponsor opt-in to shared destination evidence
residual_risk: Medium: insider at charity or compromised officer identity still passes; bounded by caps
detection: Owner-match No/partial; name similarity without exact legal-name match; account reused across EINs; claim from new email domain
existing_requirement_ids: UNB-CHAR-014; UNB-CHAR-028; UNB-CHAR-029; CNV-PAY-002; RR-REQ-X-005-r1; UNB-RCN-GRT-017; CNV-PLT-003; WFM-13

threat: Fraudulent EIN submission (lookalike or reused EIN; shell with similar name)
attack_path: Directory/grant request names a shell entity with near-identical name or a valid EIN of a different (dormant) org; payee legal name differs subtly
blast_radius_without_controls: All sponsors whose donors pick the lookalike from shared search
controls: Deterministic EIN-to-legal-name match against EO BMF/Pub78; never merge on similarity; grant to listed legal name (CNV-GRT-003); destination owner name must equal legal name or recorded DBA with evidence; duplicate/lookalike detection signal
detection: Edit-distance alerts between new entity and high-volume charities; EIN/name mismatch
existing_requirement_ids: CNV-GRT-003; UNB-CHAR-005; UNB-CHAR-028; UNB-KNOW-017; UNB-KNOW-018; CHAR-T01

threat: Lookalike domains and spoofed email (charity, sponsor or Unbound)
attack_path: Registers charity-name or unbound/sponsor lookalike domain; emails sponsor ops or charity finance with 'new bank details' or 'verify your account' links
blast_radius_without_controls: Many charities if a phishing campaign impersonates Unbound/sponsor notification emails network-wide
controls: No bank-change via email (portal-only, WFM-13 T01/T02); callback ignores contacts in request (UNB-UI-P-005); DMARC p=reject on Unbound and sponsor white-label domains; lookalike-domain monitoring; notification emails never contain action links for bank changes; published verification page
detection: Domain-age and edit-distance check on requester email domain; DMARC aggregate reports

threat: Compromised charity email or portal account (account takeover)
attack_path: Takes over a legitimate charity user's email and Unbound/partner portal login; requests bank change from a genuine account (Cargill pattern)
affected_assets: Destination; charity contact channels; grant notices
blast_radius_without_controls: All sponsors paying the charity if the changed destination is shared
controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for charity admins able to change destinations; contact-channel change hold for charity principals (extend CNV-PLT-011); notify all charity admins + previous contact; callback to contact unchanged >=30 days sourced outside the portal; D2/D3 cooling; receipt confirmation
residual_risk: Medium: attacker controlling both email and callback phone (SIM swap) can pass; mitigated by notification to all admins and cooling
detection: New device/IP; contact change followed by bank change within window; admin added then bank change

threat: BEC / fraudulent payment instructions to sponsor staff (thread hijack)
attack_path: Inserts into existing email thread with sponsor grants staff claiming charity 'changed banks' with forged W-9/bank letter (Commerce OIG, Treasure Island pattern)
blast_radius_without_controls: Single sponsor (instructions entered by that sponsor) unless the change is written to shared registry
controls: Staff cannot enter bank details from email: staff-assisted change requires confirmation on charity verified channel (WFM-13 T02); requester != verifier; callback to registry contact only; D2 cooling
detection: Change requested via staff-assisted path with no charity-portal confirmation

threat: Bank account substitution at an authoritative-looking source (NOC abuse, bank-letter forgery, bank impersonation callback)
attack_path: Forged bank letter with fraudster's phone number for 'bank confirmation'; or forged change disguised as correction
blast_radius_without_controls: Per destination; network-wide if shared
controls: Bank letters verified by calling bank via independently sourced number; NOC only from authenticated rail callback creates Pending version (WFM-13 T03); bank-originated owner match
detection: Letter phone number not matching bank directory; NOC that changes owner name

threat: Unauthorized representative claim (insider-at-charity or ex-employee)
attack_path: Former finance employee retains portal access or claims authority; redirects grants to personal account
blast_radius_without_controls: Per charity, all sponsors if shared
controls: Periodic re-attestation of charity admins; officer-list cross-check vs latest 990; new representative probation (cannot change destination for 30 days); owner match must be organisation not individual; related-party check vs individuals
detection: Owner match returns an individual; representative absent from latest 990/registry
existing_requirement_ids: UNB-CHAR-014; UNB-CHAR-007; WFM-13 T04 related-party check

threat: Fraud signal propagation failure or false propagation across network
attack_path: One sponsor detects a fraudulent destination but cannot tell others (CNV-GRT-004); or false fraud flag harms innocent charity network-wide
blast_radius_without_controls: All sponsors paying the charity
controls: Destination-level (not charity-misconduct) neutral 're-verify destination' flag under written inter-sponsor agreement; public-fact holds propagate; private content never; time-bounded
residual_risk: Medium: without agreement, other sponsors remain exposed until their own checks
detection: Return codes R02/R03/R04/R17 on a shared destination

threat: Check theft, washing and alteration
attack_path: Steal mailed grant checks; alter payee/amount or counterfeit using check stock template (FinCEN 44% altered, 26% templates)
blast_radius_without_controls: Per check; templates can reuse sponsor check stock across many charities
controls: Payee-name positive pay with daily issue files incl. voids (CNV-PAY-002); prefer electronic for repeat grantees; USPS tracking; stop-payment API; void at 90 days
detection: Positive pay exceptions; duplicate presentment; charity non-receipt
proposed_requirement: none (covered); recommend payee-name positive pay explicitly

threat: Malicious directory submission / registry data poisoning
actor: Fraudster; competitor; activist; compromised sponsor user
attack_path: Submits corrections to shared registry (phone, website, email, DBA, address) to set up later callback or donor-search hijack
affected_assets: Shared registry payment-relevant and contact fields
blast_radius_without_controls: All sponsors and donors using shared registry; contact poisoning defeats callback network-wide
controls: Provenance tiers; payment-relevant and callback fields writable only from T1/T2 sources or verified charity principal after hold; sponsor corrections re-verified (CNV-GRT-004); corroboration quorum; implausible-delta quarantine; contact age rule
detection: Burst of edits from one principal; edits to contact fields of high-volume charities

threat: Prompt injection via charity website content
actor: Fraudster controlling or defacing a charity website
attack_path: Hidden text instructs AI to mark charity eligible, change contact, or summarise favourably; AI extraction proposes phone/bank from page
affected_assets: AI dossiers; stewardship queue; registry claims
blast_radius_without_controls: Every dossier generated from that page for any sponsor
controls: CNV-AIO-002 deterministic section separate; untrusted content quoted as data; AI may not write payment-relevant fields; extracted contacts are T6 and unusable for callback
detection: Injection-pattern scanner on ingested text (alert only); diff between AI narrative and deterministic findings

threat: Prompt injection or forged content in uploaded documents (bank letters, 990 PDFs, IRS letters)
attack_path: Uploads PDF with embedded instructions or forged determination letter; AI extraction auto-fills EIN/bank; reviewer trusts AI summary
blast_radius_without_controls: Per charity; network-wide if extraction feeds shared store
controls: Documents are claims (UNB-CHAR-014); EIN/status from IRS primary only; bank details from documents never auto-activate; extraction displayed side-by-side with source image; hash stored (UNB-CHAR-008)
detection: Document metadata anomalies; mismatch of extracted EIN vs BMF

threat: Compromised or spoofed authoritative data feed (IRS BMF/Pub78/auto-revocation; state registries)
attack_path: DNS/MITM or poisoned mirror serves altered CSV (e.g., reinstates revoked org, mass false revocations, changed addresses); IRS page lists no checksum
blast_radius_without_controls: Entire network (shared reference data)
controls: Fetch only from allowlisted irs.gov hosts over verified TLS; store raw hash and posting date; delta plausibility vs prior snapshot; cross-source consistency (BMF vs TEOS vs Pub78 vs auto-revocation); favourable changes need corroboration; mass-change circuit breaker with time-bounded verification-pending
detection: Record count/delta anomalies; cross-source disagreement

threat: IRS-of-record contact/address manipulation
attack_path: Files address change with IRS (e.g., Form 8822-B) or e-Postcard to alter 'authoritative' address used for postcard verification
affected_assets: T1 contact data; postcard claim flows
blast_radius_without_controls: Network-wide where postcard/990 contacts anchor callbacks
controls: Treat T1 contact changes as recent for 60 days (no use for callback/postcard alone); require second independent channel
detection: Address change in IRS source shortly before claim/bank change

threat: Cross-sponsor information leakage via shared stores
attack_path: Infers another sponsor's grants or investigations from shared timestamps, re-check triggers, destination 'last verified' dates, search ranking or embeddings
blast_radius_without_controls: All sponsors on shared stores
controls: SharedStoreRegister with inference risks (CNV-TEN-001); sponsor-triggered re-checks not visible cross-tenant; shared fields exclude 'verified by' and per-sponsor timestamps; tenant-scoped embeddings (UNB-TEN-009); negative tests CHAR-T10/T17
detection: Access-pattern anomaly on shared store queries
existing_requirement_ids: CNV-TEN-001; CNV-GRT-004; UNB-CHAR-036; UNB-TEN-007; UNB-TEN-009; UNB-KNOW-012

threat: Improper reuse of private verification evidence
attack_path: Bank letter or callback evidence collected by sponsor A silently satisfies sponsor B's DestinationEvidence minimum
affected_assets: Charity banking data; sponsor A confidentiality; B's control assurance
blast_radius_without_controls: All opted-in sponsors inherit A's possible error
controls: Reuse only as input (CNV-GRT-003); derived assertion only (type, date, verifier class), never document; charity consent + provider sponsor opt-in + consumer sponsor opt-in; consumer sponsor still applies own tier minimum
detection: Reuse ledger audit

threat: Systemic fraud via shared destination verification (single poisoned verification paid by many)
attack_path: Defeats one verification (e.g., at the first sponsor) then harvests grants from all sponsors reusing it during the window before detection
blast_radius_without_controls: N sponsors x pending grants to that EIN
controls: Per-sponsor opt-in; network exposure cap during probation; per-sponsor first-payment cap; receipt confirmation before probation ends; velocity alert when many sponsors release to a newly changed destination
detection: Cross-sponsor release velocity on a destination version <60 days old

threat: Rail-partner enrolment inheritance (CNV-EXP-002) with weaker change controls
attack_path: Changes bank at partner (Ren/Chariot-type portal) whose public docs state no callback/cooling; Unbound/sponsor pays through enrolment without seeing change
blast_radius_without_controls: All sponsors using that partner for that charity
controls: Partner due diligence records partner change-control evidence class; contractual change-event notification and destination fingerprint/version; mismatch blocks (RR-REQ-X-005-r1 AC-1); exposure limits (CNV-PLT-012)
detection: Partner fingerprint change; returns

threat: Migration-file tampering
actor: Insider at predecessor/sponsor; attacker in transit
attack_path: Alters payee bank fields or inserts payees in legacy extract; or changes destinations in legacy system shortly before extraction
blast_radius_without_controls: All imported payees for that sponsor (thousands)
controls: Imported payees blocked until individually verified (UNB-UI-S-056); hashed/signed extract manifest with chain of custody; two independent extracts compared; late-change window (changed <=90 days pre-cutover = D3); compare to legacy bank payment history; independent reconciler (UNB-UI-S-057)
detection: Manifest hash mismatch; diff between extracts; destination never paid historically
existing_requirement_ids: UNB-CHAR-041; UNB-TEN-011; UNB-TEN-013; UNB-UI-S-056; UNB-UI-S-057; CNV-EXP-002

threat: Insider threat during onboarding/migration (Unbound or sponsor staff)
attack_path: Uses migration operator or Administrator delegation to approve own inserted destinations or to edit shared registry contacts
blast_radius_without_controls: Cross-sponsor for Unbound administrators
controls: Unbound staff never verifier/activator of sponsor destinations; SoD (importer != verifier); ServiceDelegation excludes payee-destination authority; two-person rule for registry payment-relevant writes; anomaly detection on administrators touching multiple sponsors
detection: Administrator action across >1 sponsor on payment-relevant fields
existing_requirement_ids: CNV-TEN-001; UNB-UI-S-056 AC-1; UNB-UI-S-057 AC-2; UNB-RULE-020

threat: Donor-side: credential-sharing widgets and grant-request redirection to sham charity
attack_path: Charity-site widget harvests DAF credentials or steers donor to lookalike charity
blast_radius_without_controls: Per donor
controls: Phishing-resistant auth (CNV-PLT-003); OAuth-style scoped grants only; lookalike-charity warning at recommendation; name/EIN confirmation display
detection: Login from widget IP ranges; recommendation to newly-created entity

threat: Denial of payment through mass false holds (availability attack)
actor: Attacker via poisoned feed or false reports
attack_path: Triggers network-wide holds on many charities; violates CNV-LEG-001 if holds become indefinite
affected_assets: Grant release SLA; charity cash flow
blast_radius_without_controls: Network-wide
controls: Holds from anomalous snapshot are time-bounded 'verification pending' with SLA and sponsor escalation; holds cite source (CNV-GRT-004 AC-2); circuit breaker
detection: Hold-rate anomaly
